properties.source: India where it is within 40 km of both Nepal and Bangladesh: the intersection of Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain) admin-0 India with 40 km buffers of NE admin-0 Nepal and Bangladesh, computed in a Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection centred on 88.4E 26.6N and simplified to 0.003 deg. Both long edges are therefore the NE Nepal and Bangladesh borders, and the ends are arcs where the borders draw apart, not hand-drawn lines. The neck between the two borders is 22.5 km on NE, matching the ~22 km usually given. The corridor has no official extent: 40 km is a judgement (tools/siliguri_corridor.py), and Bhutan is not an edge because it lies 45 km from Bangladesh and 66 km from Nepal, so a lens including it runs some 150 km east along the Duars.
